title: Techniques for dealing with lack of motivation, malaise, depression
summary: Jonathan Blow gives a talk on techniques for dealing with lack of motivation, malaise and depression, originally on Twitch. He discusses observing and understanding negative emotions and thoughts.
why: HN cites it as the best motivation advice some commenters have heard, and it is often shared in procrastination threads.

quote.text: Best advice I heard was from Jonathan Blow
